instructions: Read the complete originals and held DOI sources. Compare public sources only as a separately labeled tier. Verify actual repository bytes from the given commit, using git show COMMIT:PATH in a sparse checkout. Examine the image of any decisive PDF page, not just OCR.

What do these sources establish about preparation, content, provision, recipient, transmission, publication, legal exhaustion and subsequent actions? Record dates, bounds, qualifiers and sources; distinguish what each document can prove. Are two separate commands involved? Are any material questions still open?
Seal source-first findings before seeing candidate cards or prior reviews. No status, first-end replacement, or general search coverage presumed.
